title: Occupied West Bank: Israeli forces uproot hundreds of olive trees
summary: Israeli bulldozers uprooted dozens of fruit trees in the plains of al-Lubban al-Sharqiya village, south of Nablus. “I've cared for these olive trees for 40 years, just as I cared for my own children. They uprooted about 40 olive trees,” says Fuad Daraghmeh, owner of some of the uprooted trees.
